theme: Back on dry land — an open day in St. Pete
greeting: You're back on Florida ground after the Croatia charter, Dan, and the calendar is empty. A rare open Monday before Tuesday's pickup and the Orlando run kick everything back into gear.

needsAttention.title: Pickup at 3, then the Orlando drive
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow the girls get picked up at 3 PM and it's roughly two hours on to the Royal Palms villa. The Sept 20–Oct 5 rental car and a grocery stop both feed into that day, so worth firming the sequence today.

needsAttention.title: A St Pete bed for the landing gap
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 20–22 gap before pickup is still open in Todoist as a p1 — you're in St Pete now and need somewhere for tonight.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: The refundable full-size SUV out of Portland is a week overdue in Todoist. Holiday inventory in that market sells out, so a refundable hold now costs nothing and closes the risk.

flagged.title: LinkedIn messages waiting
flagged.detail: Two LinkedIn messages are flagged as awaiting your reply, including one from Claudia — worth a glance given the active search.

inbox.noise: Everything else is newsletters and promotions — NYT Cooking, Responsible Investor, sailing and language digests, a few retail and travel offers.

recipe.title: Roasted pumpkin soup
recipe.why: Early autumn is peak season for winter squash and pumpkins at the market.

tasks.title: Plan the grocery stop before the Orlando villa

acts.line: First full day back on Florida ground after the charter, with nothing on the calendar.
A genuinely open stretch — the only real pull is squaring away tomorrow's logistics.
Quiet ahead of a busy Tuesday, so an easy evening to reset.
